title: aug-2015-sexual-offences-definitive-guideline-web.pdf — section 11
text:
STEP SIX
Totality principle
If sentencing an offender for more than one offence, or where the offender is already serving a sentence,
consider whether the total sentence is just and proportionate to the offending behaviour.

STEP SEVEN
Ancillary orders
The court must consider whether to make any ancillary orders. The court must also consider what other
requirements or provisions may automatically apply. Further information is included at Annex A on
page 153.

STEP EIGHT
Reasons
Section 174 of the Criminal Justice Act 2003 imposes a duty to give reasons for, and explain the effect of,
the sentence.

STEP NINE
Consideration for time spent on bail
The court must consider whether to give credit for time spent on bail in accordance with section 240A of
the Criminal Justice Act 2003.
